mapper.select: SELECT id, session_id AS sessionId, role, content, tool_name AS toolName, is_deleted AS isDeleted, gmt_created AS gmtCreated, gmt_modified AS gmtModified FROM agent_message WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY gmt_created ASC, pk_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM agent_message WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT content FROM agent_message WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY gmt_created DESC, pk_id DESC LIMIT 1
